classifiedFinding.title: Reward tokens left in contract when totalStaked drops to zero are non-recoverable (no admin sweep); abandoned pools strand budget

classification.assetImpact: Funds-locking on pool sunset / migration. No theft. Mitigated by the design assumption that the pool operates indefinitely.
attackPath: 1. All stakers exit (via unstake or emergencyWithdraw).
2. Contract retains phUSD = pre-exit committedDebt-forfeit + donation residue.
4. Funds locked unless new stakers arrive.
classification.likelihood: low - depends on operator deciding to sunset the pool.
classification.assumptions: Pool reaches a state where all stakers have exited and no future stakers arrive.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Fund-recovery gap. Combined with L-01 (donation perturbation) the lock-in concern compounds. Recommendation: add an owner-only sweep gated on totalStaked == 0, or document indefinite-operation as an explicit deployment assumption.
